_note: Automation recipes. Instructional, no experience claims. Tools named are examples; swap for what the reader already has.

slides.big_caption: automations we'd have running by month three
slides.title: Not the fancy ones. The five that stop small things falling through the cracks.
slides.subtitle: Each one is six nodes or fewer in n8n, Make or Zapier. Build time is an afternoon each if you've done one before, a weekend if you haven't.

slides.title: Every form fill becomes a CRM record and a Slack ping, with the company looked up

nodes.label: Post to #leads with a one-line summary
Reply within an hour, every time

slides.note: The win isn't speed. It's that nobody has to remember to check the form inbox.

slides.title: Tickets get sorted before a human reads them

nodes.label: Draft a reply from your help docs
Send draft to a human for one-click approve
Reply goes out, labelled, in under 10 min

slides.note: Keep the human approve step for at least a month. Then look at what they never edit.

slides.title: Unpaid invoices chase themselves, politely

nodes.label: Day 20: Slack the founder to call

slides.note: Most late payments are forgotten, not refused. The first reminder clears half of them.

slides.title: Monday 8am, the numbers arrive before anyone asks
slides.note: If the summary ever says 'everything is fine', fix the prompt. Something is never fine.

slides.title: One long thing becomes five short things

nodes.label: New blog post or call recording
Draft 5 posts in your voice, with a 'do not post' flag
Human edits in a Notion board
Scheduled by a person, not a bot

slides.note: The bot drafts. A person decides. The posts that skip the person are the ones readers flag as slop.

slides.title: n8n vs Make vs Zapier, for a startup
rows: Free tier that covers five automations
slides.note: If nobody on the team has run Docker, start on Make. Move to n8n when the bill makes you wince.

slides.kicker: The rule we keep coming back to
slides.text: Automate the thing you've done by hand twenty times. Not the thing you imagine doing.

slides.title: Which of the five would you build first?
slides.body: Tell us in the comments. The most-requested one gets a full node-by-node build next week.
